record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
The Clio mobile app helps you stay profitable and productive by accessing essential case and client information remotely. Update case statuses, communicate with clients and firm members, and review, share, or scan documents all from the palm of your hand.

KEY FEATURES

CAPTURE AND BILL FOR MORE TIME–Track billable and non-billable time on the spot.

・Increase profitability with time-tracking tools, expense categories, and custom billing rates.

WORK FROM ANYWHERE–Quickly access client, case, billing, and calendar information wherever you are.

・Stay on top of your day with a dynamic calendar and task lists.

KEEP IN TOUCH WITH CLIENTS–Communicate with clients securely and conveniently.

・Get instantly notified when a client messages you through the client portal or text message, and respond directly from the app.

MAKE IT EASY TO GET PAID–Accept in-person payments with Tap to Pay on iPhone.

・Get paid in-person with no terminal or extra hardware needed. Clients simply hold their debit card, credit card, or digital wallet to your phone and the payment is automatically recorded in Clio.

HAVE PEACE OF MIND–Rest assured knowing Clio has industry leading security and is approved by over 100 global bar associations and legal societies.

・Don’t risk losing important paper files or exposing client data by securely storing client and case data in the cloud.

TRACK TIME USING SIRI–Start and stop timers without interrupting your workflow. 

・Say “Siri, start a timer in Clio” to start the timer, then “Siri, stop timer in Clio” to stop it. It’s hands-free and convenient, helping you record all of your work in real-time.

TURN PAPER DOCUMENTS INTO PDFS–Save files to Clio from anywhere with no extra hardware required. 

・Scan documents from anywhere while automatically cropping out messy backgrounds and combining multiple pages into one file—leaving you with clean and professional PDFs.

LEVERAGE LEGAL AI–Get the answers you need in an instant.

・Get invoices drafted, checked, and routed to the right approvers automatically and leave writer’s block behind when you generate instant, professional text messages and client portal replies.

SmartFriend Legal Translator makes understanding legal documents simple, fast, and stress-free. Whether you’re reading a contract, lease, policy, or agreement, SmartFriend breaks down confusing legal language into clear, human-friendly explanations you can actually understand.

Scan documents or upload PDFs and images. You can even text your SmartFriend like a real conversation and ask it any question about your document to get instant clarity.

Get summaries in plain English, “Explain Like I’m 5” explanations, analogies, and detailed breakdowns of rights, obligations, penalties, and hidden catches.

Perfect for everyday people, renters, freelancers, entrepreneurs, and anyone who wants clarity before signing ANYTHING!

Key Features:

Scan or upload legal documents (PDFs, images, files)

Explain legal text in simple English

“Explain Like I’m 5” mode for maximum clarity

Identify benefits, risks, penalties, and liabilities for each party

Text your SmartFriend in real time to ask questions, get explanations, or draft professional letters and PDF documents for you

Copy, share, and export results

Save analyzed documents for future reference

AI-powered accuracy designed for real-world legal language

SmartFriend doesn’t replace a lawyer, but it gives you confidence, clarity, and control before you make important decisions.

Legal language made human.

record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
AI Lawyer helps turn unfamiliar contracts, leases, NDAs, and other documents into a structured plain-English review.

UNDERSTAND THE DOCUMENT
• Scan pages with your camera, import a PDF or photo, or paste text
• Generate a concise summary of the document
• Compare how terms may affect each involved party
• Review financial terms and potential issues
• Build a list of questions and next steps to verify

ASK FOLLOW-UP QUESTIONS
Continue with the document assistant when a clause needs more explanation. Responses stay grounded in the document you provided and can help you prepare questions for a qualified professional.

KEEP DOCUMENTS ORGANIZED
Save analyzed documents in one place, revisit previous results, and export a structured report when you need to share your notes. Documents may sync through your private iCloud account when iCloud is available.

PRIVACY CONTROLS
Text you choose to analyze is sent through a developer-operated proxy to Anthropic for AI processing. Optional personal-information masking can reduce detected names, contact details, and other sensitive text before analysis, but automated detection may miss information. Review the in-app Privacy Policy before uploading confidential material.

AI output can be incomplete or wrong. AI Lawyer is an informational document-analysis tool, not a lawyer or law firm, and it does not provide legal advice. Verify important terms and decisions with a qualified professional.

Available in-app purchases may include analysis credits, chat messages, and an optional auto-renewing unlimited-access subscription. Current prices, billing periods, and terms are shown in Apple's purchase sheet before confirmation.

▶ Is it time for a lawyer or legal services? Right now! 
Romates are LLM legal assistants designed and tuned to make legal and legal documents easier to understand. From highlighting key provisions to providing scope for reference costs for legal services to pointing out potential risks, this lawyer app helps users learn and prepare before consulting with a lawyer. 

If there is a situation where you need the help of a lawyer, collect information with the lawyer app and check what you need. Even if you're not a legal professional, you can explore legal proceedings, gain knowledge about contracts, and demand them in your rights with just a few taps. 

AI lawyers now assist you with threats and contracts. 

▶ Key Features 
【 Scan AI Law from Image 】 
- Upload your contract, confirmation, or policy photo and get a streamlined summary with AI-based legal highlights. 
- Scan mindless and complex documents easily and get insights quickly. 

【 Legal cost estimator and attorney's commission cost 】 
- Check the scope of reference costs for procedures such as contracts, litigation, or filing documents (for informative purposes, not legal advice). 

【 Risk Awareness 】 
• Detect any legal issues that may arise in a document or text and understand any potential issues before consulting a lawyer. 
• What if you're signing the wrong contract? It's terrible. It can quickly legally protect and support you from the risks you may face 

【 24/7 AI legal information and multilingual legal support 】 
- Access general legal information, legal concepts, and legal procedures at any time and anywhere (not on behalf of a licensed attorney). 
- Explore legal and legal information in different countries and languages. 

▶ Data Source 
Our app uses public, open access, and non-profit legal data sources. We do not partner with government agencies or law firms. 

【 Third-Party AI Service Data Transmission Disclosure 】 
• Types of data transmitted: User's country, question text, text for identifying unreasonable legal provisions, and the following inputs for calculating legal service retainer fees: legal case details, hourly retainer rate, case importance, and expert witness costs.
• Data recipients: Third-party vendors, including LLM and infrastructure providers such as Llama AI, Groq, and Cloudflare.
• User consent: By using this app, users automatically consent to the data transmission described above.
• Note: The only personal data transmitted is the user's country and question content. No personally identifiable information (PII) is collected at any point — this includes registration, external login, and local login functions.
• Future compliance: Should the app begin collecting personally identifiable data (e.g., through account registration), such practices will be disclosed in accordance with applicable international law.

record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Struggling to make sense of lengthy contracts, legal documents, terms & conditions, or privacy policies? Legal Document Summarizer AI is here to streamline your workload—whether you’re a legal professional, a busy business owner, or simply someone who needs to get to the bottom line without wading through hundreds of pages.

Key Benefits:
	•	Time-Saver: Quickly extract the key points from extensive legal documents, contracts, or policies so you can focus on what really matters.
	•	Export Summaries: You can export the summaries as PDF or simply save them in the app and always have access to them from the main interface!
	•	Versatility: Upload documents in multiple formats—including PDFs, DOCX, TXT—and even paste or scan text directly using your camera.
	•	Handwriting Recognition: Struggling with handwritten notes or forms? Our app can read and summarize handwriting too.
	•	Customizable Tone: Choose a formal legal tone for professional use or a simpler, more accessible language for everyday clarity.
	•	User-Friendly Experience: Whether you’re in the legal industry, managing a business, or just need a clearer understanding of complex documents, our intuitive interface makes it easy to get actionable insights quickly.

Extra Use Cases:
	•	Contract Negotiations: Save time by rapidly summarizing lengthy contracts to identify crucial points before negotiations..
	•	Privacy & Compliance: Quickly review and understand privacy policies and terms, ensuring you’re always in compliance.
	•	Educational Tool: Great for law students and individuals learning about legal terminology; see complex documents broken down into key points.
	•	Business Efficiency: Enables business owners to process legal materials with ease, speeding up decision-making and reducing reliance on professional legal counsel for routine reviews.

With Legal Document Summarizer AI, managing your legal documents becomes less of a chore and more of a streamlined, efficient process—all at your fingertips.

Important: The information provided by the App is for informational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice. The App is not intended to replace a licensed attorney, legal expert, or professional legal counsel. It is designed solely as an aid to assist users in understanding the general content of legal documents. For any legal decisions or actions, users should consult with a qualified legal professional.

record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Lea is a trauma-informed AI companion for people navigating abuse, harassment, stalking, cyberbullying, and situations that simply don’t feel right.

Talk or type, anytime, in the language you feel most comfortable using.

You don’t need a court case, a police report, or a story that sounds “serious enough” to use Lea. If something feels uncomfortable, controlling, frightening, unsafe, or wrong, you can start there.

Many survivors only understand or name what happened much later. Lea can help you recognize patterns of abuse, coercion, harassment, and control, so you can better understand what may be happening and what you may want to do next.

With Lea, you can:
• Turn your records into evidence an attorney or therapist can actually use. Bring together screenshots, messages, documents, voice notes, dates, and your own account of what happened, then organize them into a clearer timeline and structured record for professional support.
• Understand your rights and options in plain language, without unnecessary legal jargon or judgment.
• Keep important records together privately in a PIN-protected vault with Face ID support.
• Build an organized record of what happened in your own words, including incidents, dates, patterns, and supporting evidence, so you don’t have to reconstruct everything from memory when you meet with an attorney or therapist.
• Learn at your own pace through short audio lessons and longer episodes covering topics survivors commonly face, from sexual harassment and property issues to legal processes and Courtroom 101.
• Find trauma-informed specialists and local support that may fit what you need.
• Rebuild what comes next with Coach Lea, including your résumé, financial plan, goals, reflections, and practical steps toward greater independence.
• Connect and be heard in a community designed with gentle safeguards around difficult or sensitive content.
• Use Lea more discreetly when privacy matters. Quick Exit helps you leave the app quickly, Disguise Mode can make Lea look like something else on your screen, and billing can be disguised so the name of the service does not have to appear obviously on shared financial records. Lea also supports a discreet cover screen, PIN protection, and Face ID.

Lea helps turn what you have lived through into something organized, understandable, and usable.

Use Lea before meeting an attorney or therapist to organize what happened, preserve important records, prepare better questions, and turn scattered information into evidence and context they can work with. Use it between meetings so everything stays in one place, or while you are still deciding what you want to do next.

Lea is not a lawyer, therapist, or legal service, and it does not replace professional legal or mental health advice.

You decide what to share, what to save, and what happens next. Lea moves at your pace.

Meet Clausely, Clausely is an AI-powered legal document intelligence app that helps individuals and businesses understand complex legal documents without needing a law degree.

UNDERSTAND ANY CONTRACT IN SECONDS BEFORE YOU SIGN.

Most people sign contracts, leases, NDAs, and employment agreements without fully understanding the terms because the language is too dense, and professional legal review is expensive and slow. Clausely provides instant clarity by translating legal jargon into plain English.

KEY FEATURES

Instant AI-powered analysis of legal documents (PDFs, Word docs, or camera-scanned paper contracts) in under 60 seconds. 
- Plain-English summaries identifying parties, obligations, payment terms, and termination clauses
- Automated risk detection that flags hidden or unfair clauses (e.g., automatic renewals, unusual liability shifts) with severity ratings
- An interactive clause explainer and document Q&A ("Ask Clausely") so users can ask specific questions about their contracts
- A document history dashboard to store and revisit past analyses

WHO IT’S FOR

Individuals reviewing personal contracts (leases, employment agreements), small business owners, freelancers, and anyone who needs a quick "first pass" on legal documents before deciding whether to consult a lawyer.

Important disclaimer: Clausely is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice. It is an informational tool meant to supplement, not replace, professional legal counsel.

Legal questions don't wait for office hours. Lawyers charge $200–400 an hour. LegalLens gives you clear, sourced legal information for $4.99 a month — so you can understand your rights, your options, and your next steps before that bill arrives.

Lex, your AI legal companion, reads relevant statutes and case law from your jurisdiction, then explains them in plain English. Every answer cites the specific law it pulled from. No cryptic language, no $200 consultations to ask one question.

— USE LEGALLENS WHEN —

• Your landlord won't return your security deposit
• You were fired without notice — what are your rights?
• You're about to sign a contract and need to understand the fine print
• You're filing a small claims complaint
• You have visa or immigration questions
• You're navigating custody, divorce, or family law
• You got pulled over and want to know what to do
• A neighbor dispute is escalating
• You inherited something and don't know the tax implications

— FEATURES —

• Ask anything, get sourced answers — every reply cites real statutes and case law
• Document Studio — 14+ legal templates (resignation letters, eviction notices, complaints, demand letters) tailored to your jurisdiction and language
• Scan & Modify — photograph any document, edit specific clauses, get back a polished PDF
• Voice mode — talk to Lex, get spoken answers; perfect for hands-free or on the go
• 10 languages — English, Turkish, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese (BR), Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified)
• 50+ jurisdictions — every US state, plus UK, Germany, Turkey, France, Italy, Spain, Brazil, Japan, Korea, China, and more
• Web search — fetch the latest rulings and statutes when database answers aren't current enough
• Private by design — your questions stay yours; no profile sold to anyone
• Face ID app lock for sensitive conversations
• Save, share, and export your conversations and drafted documents

— PLANS —

Free: A few daily questions to get a feel for it.
Plus ($4.99/mo or $44.99/yr): 150 credits/month, multi-jurisdiction access, document drafting, web search.
Pro ($14.99/mo or $129.99/yr): 500 credits/month, all jurisdictions, priority responses, App Lock, unlimited history.
3-day free trial on all paid plans. Cancel anytime in Settings.

Credit packs (one-time): 10 credits ($2.99), 50 credits ($9.99), 100 credits ($14.99) — for users who don't want a subscription.

— FAQ —

Q: Is this legal advice?
A: No. LegalLens provides legal *information* — like a deeply-read research assistant. For decisions with real consequences, always consult a licensed attorney.

Q: How accurate is it?
A: Answers are grounded in actual statutes and case law, with citations you can verify. We're transparent when something is jurisdiction-specific or recently changed. Use the web search feature for the latest rulings.

Q: What's the data freshness?
A: Our legal database is updated regularly. For the most recent rulings or amendments, the web search feature pulls live results.

Q: Is my data private?
A: Yes. We don't sell your data. Conversations stay on your device unless you sign in to sync. We're privacy-first — see our policy at legallens-app.vercel.app.

Q: Can I cancel?
A: Yes — anytime in iPhone Settings → Subscriptions. The 3-day free trial doesn't bill if you cancel before it ends.

— IMPORTANT —

LegalLens is for educational and informational purposes. It does NOT establish an attorney-client relationship. For decisions about your specific situation, consult a licensed attorney in your jurisdiction.

Privacy Policy: https://legallens-app.vercel.app/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Draft the legal document you need by answering plain questions. Understand a contract before you sign it. Ask a legal question and get a straight answer. A free allowance of each, every day.

AI Legal Assistant is for tenants, landlords, employees, employers, freelancers, business owners, and anyone meeting something legal for the first time.


DRAFT A DOCUMENT

16 ready templates, each asking only the questions that document actually needs:

Lease Agreement · Real Estate · Property Ownership · Selling a Car · Marriage Certificate · Divorce · Domestic Partnership · Name Change · Employee Contract · Service Contract · Last Will & Testament · Lending Money · Copyright Registration · Privacy Policy · Criminal Charges · Non-Criminal Certificate


Need something else? Describe it in your own words and it gets written.

• Set your jurisdiction and the governing law
• Add other parties, and any clauses of your own
• Choose the length, from one page to ten
• Write the document in a different language from the app


EDIT IT UNTIL IT IS RIGHT

• Type straight into the document
• Or ask for a change in plain words — "60 days notice" — and it is rewritten around your edits
• Rename it. It saves itself as you go.


UNDERSTAND A DOCUMENT

Upload a PDF, or photograph a contract with your camera, and have it explained in plain language.

• Ask it to focus on deadlines, costs and fees, risks and penalties, or how to end the agreement
• The summary opens as a conversation, so you can keep asking about it


ASK A LEGAL QUESTION

Describe what happened the way you would to a friend. You get a straight answer, not a page of jargon.

• 12 areas of law: personal injury, family, criminal, employment, business and corporate, real estate, estate planning and probate, immigration, consumer protection, environmental, intellectual property, and tax
• Keep a conversation to one area, or ask about anything
• Ask follow-up questions in the same conversation
• Suggested questions, for when you are not sure where to start


TAKE IT WITH YOU — FREE

Share or save any answer, conversation or document as Word, PDF or plain text. Exporting is free and never counted against your daily allowance.


YOUR WORK STAYS ON YOUR PHONE

Chats and documents are kept on the device, not in an account somewhere. Search them, and undo a deletion if you change your mind.


NO SIGN-UP

No email, no password, no account screen. Open the app and ask.


FREE EVERY DAY

Questions, case summaries and documents come back on a daily allowance, 24 hours after they last refilled. Work that fails costs you nothing.

VIP removes those three limits — and only those. Every template, every language and every export format is already free for everyone.


BUILT TO BE USED BY ANYONE

8 languages · dark mode · large text sizes · right-to-left layouts


Important: this app gives AI-generated information for general purposes. It is not legal advice, and using it does not create a lawyer-client relationship. Laws differ from one place to another. For anything that matters, have a qualified lawyer look at it.

Spend less time writing up client meetings. LexVoda turns recorded conversations, legal dictation, and imported audio into editable transcripts and structured draft file notes. Transcription and AI drafting run entirely on your device—without uploading matter content to cloud AI.

Built for lawyers and legal professionals, LexVoda keeps your source audio, transcript, and draft file note together, ready for you to review, edit, and export.

TRY FIVE MATTERS FREE
Start with five free matters. No subscription or LexVoda account is required to get started. Upgrade to LexVoda Pro for unlimited on-device transcription and draft file-note generation.

DEVICE REQUIREMENTS
Requires a supported device with at least 8 GB of RAM so LexVoda can run its AI directly on your device.

FROM CLIENT CONVERSATION TO DRAFT FILE NOTE
• Record client meetings, conferences, and interviews.
• Dictate notes after a meeting while the details are fresh.
• Import existing audio recordings.
• Generate a transcript and structured draft file note on your device.
• Review and edit the generated content.
• Organize your recordings and notes by matter.

PRIVATE, ON-DEVICE AI
Transcription and draft file-note generation work offline. Your recordings and matter content are not uploaded to a cloud AI service for processing.
Structured matter data is stored in an encrypted local database. Audio recordings and other app files use the security protections provided by your device and operating system.
Enable App Lock to protect access to your workspace. Choose to delete audio automatically after transcription. 

EXPORT FOR YOUR WORKFLOW
• Export transcripts and draft file notes as PDF, RTF, or TXT.
• Share or save retained audio recordings as M4A.

LEXVODA PRO
A monthly or annual subscription unlocks unlimited on-device transcription and draft file-note generation. Purchases and subscription management are handled through the App Store.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION
LexVoda is an assistive drafting tool for legal professionals. It does not provide legal advice or replace professional judgment. AI-generated transcripts and file notes may contain errors or omissions. Always review, verify, and edit generated content before relying on it.
You are responsible for applicable recording, consent, privacy, confidentiality, and professional obligations. Obtain any required notice or permission before recording.

Whether you are preparing for a courtroom trial, a university exam, or trying to understand a legal contract, this app ensures you have the right legal information at your fingertips—anytime, anywhere.

KEY FEATURES

AI Deep Dive
Go beyond basic definitions. Our built-in Legal AI provides simplified explanations, real-world legal scenarios, and key takeaways for complex terms to help you understand the “why” and “how” behind the law.

100% Offline Search
No internet connection required. Access a powerful database of over 5,000+ legal terms even in remote areas or places with no connectivity. Fast, reliable, and always available.

Gamified Learning and Daily Engagement
Daily Legal Quiz – Test yourself with a 5-question legal quiz every day.
Learning Streaks – Build a daily habit of learning with streak tracking.
Word of the Day – Learn one new legal term every 24 hours.

Legal Maxims Library
Understand the foundation of law with a dedicated collection of Latin Legal Maxims and their practical meanings in modern legal systems.

Smart Productivity Tools
Custom Collections – Organize saved terms into folders like Criminal Law, Exam Prep, or Client Notes.
Personal Study Notes – Add your own private notes to any legal term.
PDF Export – Convert saved terms and notes into a professional PDF study guide for sharing or printing.

Multilingual Translation
Translate legal definitions into 100+ languages, including Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi, Tamil, Spanish, and French, making legal knowledge accessible in your native language.

Modern and Professional UI
Enjoy a premium interface with a sticky search bar, modern squircle-style icons, and full support for Light and Dark Mode to reduce eye strain during long study sessions.

WHO IS THIS APP FOR

Law Students – Ideal for LLB, LLM, and bar exam preparation.
Legal Professionals – Quick reference for advocates, attorneys, and paralegals.
Judicial Exam Aspirants – A valuable tool for competitive legal examinations.
General Public – Understand legal terms used in contracts, notices, and documents.

Download Law Dictionary Offline : AI today and elevate your legal knowledge with the power of offline intelligence.

record.description_evidence:
Verdict (formerly LexGPT) is an AI legal assistant that explains the law where you live in plain words. Ask a legal question by typing or speaking, get a risk report on a contract or notice, draft letters, notices and agreements as PDF, and keep everything about a legal issue in one private place.

Verdict covers the United States state by state, India (the new BNS, BNSS and BSA with the old IPC, CrPC and Evidence Act sections), the United Kingdom, the UAE, Canada, Australia and more than 100 other countries. It gives legal information, not legal advice. It is not a lawyer or a law firm.

Know where you stand.

Ask a legal question
• Type or speak, and attach a document if it helps.
• Answers follow your country and state, name the Act and section when sure, and end with what to do next.
• With Pro, Verdict checks official sources when a question needs current facts, and cites them.
• Answers in 29 languages, including English, Spanish, Hindi, Arabic and Chinese.

Review a contract or notice
• Scan or upload a lease, job offer, NDA, loan agreement or legal notice.
• Get a risk report: a verdict such as "Negotiate first", a fairness score out of 100, and risky clauses quoted word for word, each with why it matters and what to ask for.
• Key dates, money and obligations are pulled out; dates become reminders.

Draft letters, notices and agreements
• 18 guided templates, from a demand letter, deposit refund notice or consumer complaint to a rental agreement, NDA, affidavit, power of attorney or cease and desist letter.
• Answer a few questions, choose a tone, edit, and export a clean PDF.

Know your rights
• Guides for renting, work and pay, shopping, family, police and arrest, online fraud, money, property, driving, health, education and travel.
• Each guide: your rights and the law behind them, steps to take, evidence to keep, where to go and time limits.

Look up the law
• Search an Act, a section or a plain question, such as "Fair Housing Act", "deposit rules in California" or "BNS 318", and get a plain-word summary, elements, penalties, exceptions and an example.

Matters and deadlines
• One matter per legal issue: conversations, documents, deadlines, notes and a timeline.
• Reminders on the day and three days before a deadline.
• With Pro, a case brief for your lawyer, exported as PDF.

Private by design
• Conversations, matters and documents are stored on your iPhone.
• The vault encrypts files on your device (AES-256) and opens with Face ID or your passcode.
• Verdict's servers don't keep the text of your questions or documents. No ads.

Who it's for
Tenants, employees, freelancers, small business owners and families with an everyday legal problem: a deposit not returned, unpaid wages, a notice in the mail, a contract to sign, an online scam. Verdict can't represent you, but it helps you prepare.

Free and Pro
The free plan includes 3 questions, 3 look-ups and 3 voice questions a day, 1 document review and 1 draft a month, and a vault for 10 files. Verdict Pro (weekly, monthly or yearly) adds daily document reviews and drafts, case briefs, cited official sources, an unlimited vault and much higher limits (fair use).

Subscription terms
• Verdict Pro is an auto-renewing subscription. Prices are shown in the app before you buy and vary by country.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
• It renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; renewal is charged within 24 hours before the period ends.
• Manage or cancel any time in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions.
• Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://lexgpt-support-site.vercel.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://lexgpt-support-site.vercel.app/privacy-policy

For court dates, criminal charges or urgent deadlines, contact a lawyer or your local legal aid service.

Wakil AI is your pocket legal assistant for Uzbekistan, it's built to help individuals, entrepreneurs, and professionals navigate the country's laws with clarity and confidence.

Ask any legal question in plain language and get instant, well-reasoned answers backed by citations from official sources on lex.uz. Whether you're reviewing a contract, preparing for court, or just trying to understand your rights, Wakil AI gives you the answers you need in seconds, not hours.

## WHAT YOU CAN DO

- Ask legal questions in natural language and get streaming, cited answers
- Upload documents (contracts, agreements, notices) for AI-powered review
- Switch between specialized assistants for different legal domains
- Browse your full conversation history across sessions
- Share any answer with colleagues or clients in a single tap
- Give feedback to help improve answer quality

## SPECIALIZED ASSISTANTS

- **General** — everyday legal questions across all areas of Uzbek law
- **Court** — litigation, procedure, and case preparation guidance
- **Tax** — tax law, obligations, and compliance questions
- **Contract Analyzer** — upload contracts and get clause-by-clause analysis

## MULTI-LANGUAGE SUPPORT

The app's interface and answers are fully available in:

- English
- Russian (Русский)
- Uzbek (O'zbek)

Switch languages anytime from Settings. Responses adapt to your chosen language while drawing from the same authoritative legal sources.

## DESIGNED FOR iOS

- Clean, native SwiftUI interface built for iPhone and iPad
- Full support for Light and Dark Mode
- Dynamic Type for comfortable reading at any size
- Haptic feedback (toggle in Settings)
- Dismiss keyboard interactively while scrolling
- Sign in securely with Google

## PRIVACY & CONTROL

- Sign in with your Google account — no separate password to remember
- Your conversations are tied to your account and syncable across devices
- Delete your account and associated data at any time from Settings

## WHO IT'S FOR

Wakil AI is built for:

- Citizens wanting to understand their legal rights and obligations
- Small business owners navigating regulations, taxes, and contracts
- Lawyers and paralegals looking for a faster research starting point
- Students studying Uzbek law

## IMPORTANT NOTE

Wakil AI provides AI-generated information based on official legal sources, but it is not a substitute for professional legal advice from a qualified attorney. For matters involving significant legal, financial, or personal consequences, always consult a licensed lawyer.

## SUPPORT

Questions or feedback? Visit wakil.ai or reach out to us directly from within the app. We're actively improving Wakil AI based on user input.

record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
The fastest way to find controlling precedent — wherever you practice.

Case Law Search gives attorneys, paralegals, and law students direct access to US federal and state appellate opinions. No clutter. No distractions. Just the cases you need, readable the way they were meant to be read.

Search federal circuit courts and state appellate courts in seconds. Precision search returns ranked results so you spend less time sifting and more time constructing your argument. Pair that with recent search history and one-tap jurisdiction filtering, and the research that used to take hours moves faster.

Reading full opinions inside the app is a different experience. Footnotes and citation references appear inline, exactly where the court placed them, so you never lose the thread of an opinion while chasing a reference. The layout is clean, distraction-free, and designed for extended reading sessions — not a hurried skim.

Save any case to your personal Briefcase. Cases are there when you need them — organized, accessible, and always a tap away. Whether you are building a brief, preparing for oral argument, or studying for finals, your research travels with you.

Pin your most-used courts for immediate access. Federal circuits, state appellate courts, or a custom mix — pin them once and filter your searches to those jurisdictions without navigating away. When your practice lives in one circuit, your app should know that.

Case Law Search opens with a personalized onboarding flow to establish your jurisdiction preferences from day one. Your Chambers profile lets you manage your account, adjust preferences, and choose between monthly and yearly Pro subscription plans as your needs evolve.

For legal professionals who treat research as a craft, Case Law Search is the tool built for that standard.

record.name: LEGIS: US Law & Legal Research
record.offering: Reference app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
The US law library that works without a signal. Search statutes, regulations and 11 million court opinions, ask the on-device AI, and get the exact section with a citation you can tap. Everything stays on your iPhone.

Built for attorneys, law students, paralegals and anyone who needs the actual text of the law, fast.

ASK A QUESTION. GET THE STATUTE.
Type a question in plain English: "What does 42 U.S.C. § 1983 say?" or "Which federal rules cover data privacy?" The AI assistant runs entirely on your device and answers with sources from the built-in library. Every answer shows you where it comes from, so you can read the primary law yourself. No queries leave your phone.

11 MILLION+ DOCUMENTS, ONE SEARCH
• US Code: every title of federal statutory law
• Code of Federal Regulations: all active titles, organized by agency
• Supreme Court: 940,000+ opinions, from the founding to today
• Federal courts: 10 million+ circuit and district court opinions
• Congress: bills and resolutions from the 118th and 119th Congress
• Federal Register: rules, proposed rules and agency notices
• State statutes: growing coverage, state by state

Search everything at once or filter by statutes, cases or Congress. Results are ranked by relevance and highlight the passage you are looking for, across millions of documents in about a second.

EVERY CITATION IS A LINK
"42 U.S.C. § 1983", "21 CFR § 314.50", "Brown v. Board of Education": LEGIS recognizes citations in the text and turns them into links. Tap to jump to the source, then keep going. Build your research chain without copying, pasting or losing your place.

WORKS IN AIRPLANE MODE
Download the libraries you need once. After that, search, reading and the AI assistant work with no connection at all. In the courtroom, on a flight, in a rural county office or anywhere phones are restricted.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No tracking. No analytics. No ads. No third-party SDKs. Your searches and questions never leave your device, which matters when you research criminal defense, employment disputes, whistleblower cases or anything confidential.

MADE FOR THE WAY LAWYERS WORK
• Browse the US Code by title, the CFR by agency, cases by court and date
• Bookmark the sections you return to
• A to Z index for fast navigation in long lists
• Clean, readable text sized for the phone

WHO USES LEGIS
• Solo practitioners and small firms who need primary law without an enterprise research contract
• Law students reading cases and preparing for the bar exam
• Paralegals checking citations and pulling statutes
• Self-represented litigants who want to read the law themselves
• Journalists, compliance teams and policy researchers

FREE AND PRO
Free: full search, browsing and reading for every library you download.
LEGIS Pro: the on-device AI assistant, bookmarks and every feature we add next.
LEGIS Pro is an auto-renewing subscription. Manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple Account settings.

TRUSTED SOURCES
All content is primary, public domain law (17 U.S.C. § 105). Statutes and regulations from the Government Publishing Office and eCFR.gov, case law from CourtListener by the Free Law Project. No proprietary headnotes, no paraphrased summaries: the actual text.

IMPORTANT
LEGIS is a research tool, not a law firm, and does not give legal advice. Always verify citations against official sources before relying on them in a proceeding. LEGIS is not affiliated with any court, legislature or government agency.

Terms of Use: https://idlewildcodeworks.com/terms
